summary: Each 4-connected same-color nonzero component is cropped to its bbox; the hole count is the number of enclosed zero regions inside the crop (4-connected zero regions that do not touch the crop border). Components are sorted by (hole_count asc, reading-order index asc) and the crops are packed left-to-right with one blank column between consecutive crops; output height = max crop height, width = sum of crop widths + (n-1) gaps.
